# Compatibility fixtures

`fixtures.json` is the executable compatibility matrix. The small ASCII files
isolate the metadata contract emitted by the named PrusaSlicer source tag; they
are synthetic contract fixtures, not complete sliced models. The BGCode binary
is generated by the exact official LibBGCode revision pinned by alpha11; its
full provenance and checksum are in `../bgcode/README.md`.

Generated BGCode matrix rows exercise CRC32 plus Deflate for single-, multi-,
and sparse eight-tool metadata. The checked-in alpha11 binary remains the
byte-for-byte upstream-library fixture; generated rows deliberately test the
container contract without pretending to be archived slicer output.

When the scheduled upstream-release check reports a new PrusaSlicer 3 or
Firmware Buddy release, add its single-tool and multi-tool outputs here before
updating `upstream-releases.json`.
